items.title: 葬礼 2063
items.one_liner: 制作周期较长，首映礼暂定 2063 年。
items.description: 一直在筹办自己的葬礼。欢迎 2063 年来参加。我是一个内向且……礼貌的人，所以葬礼可能是唯一一个场合：每个人都在和我交流，而我又不用社交。所以，我得好好筹划，不能搞砸我人生最喜欢、也最重要的时刻。毕竟我不能亲自到场，活着。

items.title: 生命之树 · Tree of Life
items.one_liner: A spiritual base for meeting change without rebuilding yourself from zero.
items.description: Tree of Life is my spiritual base: a meta mental model for keeping meaning, judgment, and direction coherent as reality changes. Rather than offering fixed answers, it gives me a stable structure for understanding reality, forming judgment, and choosing action. Its working grammar is 愿·悟·道·法·术·器·例·场·运·势. The manuscript is still under revision and has not yet been formally published; if it resonates, feel free to email me.

items.title: Good Things
items.description: An AI-native opportunity system designed to compress discovery, decision, and action into one low-friction flow.

items.title: Sense Commons
items.one_liner: A public protocol for reusable understanding.
items.description: A protocol and system for materializing sources, generating structured artifacts, and making concepts reusable across tools and contexts.

items.title: Daymap
items.description: A personal data system that reconciles multiple daily sources into a navigable record of what happened, what mattered, and what changed.

items.title: Cool Foodie
items.description: A food-understanding repository organized around entities, ADPs, artifacts, and apps — from packaged-food identity to ingredient and nutrition explanations.

items.title: TRACE
items.description: A web experiment exploring how motion, space, and fragments of story can turn a page into a navigable narrative environment.

items.title: Visual DNA
items.one_liner: Reusable visual languages, stored as data.
items.description: A data-decoupled system for defining visual DNA and rendering it through lightweight viewers instead of hard-coding a style into one app.

items.title: 宇宙基地
items.one_liner: A portable base you can rebuild anywhere in one day.
items.description: An early base8.life video essay about designing an eight-square-meter portable living base for nomadic life: modular storage, sensory and functional design, daily-use patterns, and a packable sleep system that make a familiar home easier to rebuild in a new place.

items.title: Not Today
items.one_liner: Asymmetric tower defense meets first-person combat.
items.description: A team game project built at USC around an asymmetric two-sided battle. One player enters the world in first-person and pushes through the map, while the opposing player controls the battlefield from a tower-defense view; the roles can then reverse. The project combined first-person shooting, tower-defense strategy, stereoscopic 3D, and VR into one competitive game prototype.
